name: block
description: Anchored data-display actor. A $block bridges woo to an outside-world data source: an external plug authenticates as the block's actor (apikey-bound) and pushes property values through tier-gated write verbs; the block's owner sets configuration through the same verbs. Permissions follow the LambdaMOO :is_*_by convention — overrideable per-class verbs that gate every state mutation.

classes.description: Base class for plug-driven data display. Anchored: a block stays at its placement and rejects becoming a container. Property writes go through :set_property[ies], which gate on this:is_writable_by_property(actor, name) — the LambdaMOO-shaped per-class hook. Default property policy grants wizard bypass, grants self-write of names in writable_self (so an apikey-bound plug session writes its own data props), and grants owner-write of names in writable_owner (so the block's owner sets config without touching the plug surface). Subclasses override the verb for richer policy; the writable_owner / writable_self lists are the conventional default-impl data.

verbs.name: is_writable_by
verbs.source: verb :is_writable_by(who) rxd { if ("the_perm":controls(who, this)) { return true; } if (who == this) { return true; } return false; }

verbs.name: is_writable_by_property
verbs.source: verb :is_writable_by_property(who, name) rxd { if (has_flag(who, "wizard")) { return true; } if (who == this && name in this.writable_self) { return true; } if (who == this.owner && name in this.writable_owner) { return true; } return false; }

verbs.name: set_property
verbs.source: verb :set_property(name, value) rx { if (typeof(name) != "string" || !name) { raise { code: "E_INVARG", message: "set_property requires a non-empty name", value: name }; } if (!this:is_writable_by_property(actor, name)) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "property is not writable by this actor", value: { property: name, actor: actor } }; } this.(name) = value; let here = location(this); if (here != null && isa(here, $space)) { observe_to_space(here, { type: "block_data", block: this, name: name, value: value, ts: now() }); } return value; }

verbs.name: set_properties
verbs.source: verb :set_properties(values) rx { if (typeof(values) != "map") { raise { code: "E_INVARG", message: "set_properties requires a map", value: values }; } let names = keys(values); for n in names { if (!this:is_writable_by_property(actor, n)) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "property is not writable by this actor", value: { property: n, actor: actor } }; } } let audience = location(this); let routable = audience != null && isa(audience, $space); let ts = now(); for n in names { let v = values[n]; this.(n) = v; if (routable) { observe_to_space(audience, { type: "block_data", block: this, name: n, value: v, ts: ts }); } } return values; }

verbs.name: plug_last_success_at
verbs.source: verb :plug_last_success_at() rxd { if (typeof(this.last_pushed_at) == "number" && this.last_pushed_at > 0) { return this.last_pushed_at; } return null; }

verbs.name: plug_status
verbs.source: verb :plug_status() rxd { let label = this.plug_label; if (typeof(label) != "string" || !label) { label = "Block"; } let attempted = this.last_attempt_at; if (typeof(attempted) != "number" || attempted <= 0) { attempted = null; } let succeeded = this:plug_last_success_at(); let failed = this.last_failure_at; if (typeof(failed) != "number" || failed <= 0) { failed = null; } let failures = this.consecutive_failures; if (typeof(failures) != "number" || failures < 0) { failures = 0; } let age = null; if (typeof(succeeded) == "number" && succeeded > 0) { age = now() - succeeded; if (age < 0) { age = 0; } } let state = "healthy"; let status_text = label + " plug status: healthy."; let hint = this:plug_status_hint(); if (typeof(hint) == "map" && has(hint, "state") && typeof(hint["state"]) == "string" && hint["state"]) { state = hint["state"]; if (has(hint, "message") && typeof(hint["message"]) == "string" && hint["message"]) { status_text = hint["message"]; } else { status_text = label + " plug status: " + state + "."; } } else { if (failures > 0 || this.last_error) { state = "error"; status_text = label + " plug status: error; the latest attempt failed."; } else { if (succeeded == null) { if (attempted != null) { state = "pending"; status_text = label + " plug status: an update is in progress."; } else { state = "never"; status_text = label + " plug status: no successful update yet."; } } else { let stale_after = this.plug_stale_after_ms; if (typeof(stale_after) == "number" && stale_after > 0 && age > stale_after) { state = "stale"; status_text = label + " plug status: stale; the last successful update missed its freshness window."; } } } } return { state: state, message: status_text, last_attempt_at: attempted, last_pushed_at: this.last_pushed_at, last_success_at: succeeded, last_failure_at: failed, age_ms: age, expected_interval_ms: this.plug_expected_interval_ms, stale_after_ms: this.plug_stale_after_ms, consecutive_failures: failures, last_error: this.last_error }; }

verbs.name: announce_plug_status_change
verbs.source: verb :announce_plug_status_change(before, after) rxd { if (caller != this) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "plug status announcements are block-internal" }; } if (typeof(before) != "map" || typeof(after) != "map" || before["state"] == after["state"]) { return false; } let here = location(this); if (here != null && isa(here, $space)) { observe_to_space(here, { type: "plug_status_changed", block: this, from: before["state"], to: after["state"], text: after["message"], ts: now() }); } return true; }

verbs.name: record_plug_attempt
verbs.source: verb :record_plug_attempt(at) rx { if (actor != this && !has_flag(actor, "wizard")) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "only the block actor (plug) or wizard can record an attempt", value: actor }; } let before = this:plug_status(); let ts = at; if (typeof(ts) != "number" || ts <= 0) { ts = now(); } this:set_property("last_attempt_at", ts); let after = this:plug_status(); this:announce_plug_status_change(before, after); return after; }

verbs.name: record_plug_success
verbs.source: verb :record_plug_success(values, at) rx { if (actor != this && !has_flag(actor, "wizard")) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "only the block actor (plug) or wizard can record success", value: actor }; } if (typeof(values) != "map") { raise { code: "E_INVARG", message: "record_plug_success requires a property map", value: values }; } let before = this:plug_status(); let ts = at; if (typeof(ts) != "number" || ts <= 0) { ts = now(); } values["last_attempt_at"] = ts; values["last_pushed_at"] = ts; values["consecutive_failures"] = 0; values["last_error"] = null; this:set_properties(values); let after = this:plug_status(); this:announce_plug_status_change(before, after); return after; }

verbs.name: record_plug_failure
verbs.source: verb :record_plug_failure(error_text, values, at) rx { if (actor != this && !has_flag(actor, "wizard")) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "only the block actor (plug) or wizard can record failure", value: actor }; } if (typeof(error_text) != "string" || !error_text) { raise { code: "E_INVARG", message: "record_plug_failure requires a non-empty message", value: error_text }; } if (typeof(values) != "map") { raise { code: "E_INVARG", message: "record_plug_failure requires a property map", value: values }; } let before = this:plug_status(); let ts = at; if (typeof(ts) != "number" || ts <= 0) { ts = now(); } let failures = this.consecutive_failures; if (typeof(failures) != "number" || failures < 0) { failures = 0; } values["last_attempt_at"] = ts; values["last_failure_at"] = ts; values["consecutive_failures"] = failures + 1; values["last_error"] = error_text; this:set_properties(values); let after = this:plug_status(); this:announce_plug_status_change(before, after); return after; }

verbs.name: get_data
verbs.source: verb :get_data(name) rxd { if (typeof(name) != "string" || !name) { raise { code: "E_INVARG", message: "get_data requires a non-empty name", value: name }; } if (!this:is_readable_by(actor)) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "cannot read this block", value: this }; } return this.(name); }

verbs.name: look_self
verbs.source: verb :look_self() rxd { let summary = {}; for n in this.summary_props { summary[n] = this.(n); } let plug = this:plug_status(); let text = this.description; if (typeof(text) != "string") { text = to_string(text); } if (text) { text = text + " " + plug["message"]; } else { text = plug["message"]; } return { id: this, title: this.name, description: text, plug_status: plug, last_attempt_at: this.last_attempt_at, last_pushed_at: this.last_pushed_at, last_failure_at: this.last_failure_at, consecutive_failures: this.consecutive_failures, last_error: this.last_error, summary: summary, location: location(this) }; }

verbs.name: moveto
verbs.source: verb :moveto(target) rx { if (!has_flag(actor, "wizard")) { raise { code: "E_PERM", message: "this block is anchored and cannot be moved", value: this }; } return moveto(this, target); }

verbs.name: acceptable
verbs.source: verb :acceptable(object) rxd { if (has_flag(actor, "wizard")) { return true; } return false; }
